aboutPreview.founderQuote: Culture is the root of community pride; selfless service is the water that nurtures it.
aboutPreview.storyP1: Founded in 2006 in Indira Nagar, Nashik, Shree Pratisthan was established under the visionary guidance of our elders to unite local youth through authentic Maharashtrian cultural celebrations and committed social relief.
aboutPreview.storyP2: Over nearly two decades, our volunteer brotherhood has organized Nashik's grandest eco-friendly Ganeshotsav, youth Dhol-Tasha training, voluntary blood donation camps, senior welfare programs, and relief drives for drought-affected farmers.
aboutPreview.pillar1Desc: Preserving classical Maharashtrian festival pageantry, eco-friendly clay idols, and devotional art.
aboutPreview.pillar2Desc: Nurturing discipline, musical excellence, and civic pride through Shree Naad Dhol Tasha Troupe.
aboutPreview.pillar3Desc: Delivering free healthcare drives, environmental conservation, and educational support across Nashik.

testimonials.title: Voices of Our Founding Pillars
testimonials.subtitle: Hear from the citizens, volunteers, and patrons who inspire our daily mission.
testimonials.t1Desc: What began in 2006 as daily cricket sessions among friends in Indira Nagar has evolved into a registered trust serving culture, sports, and community with unshakeable brotherhood and dedication.
testimonials.t2Desc: From annual sports tournaments to youth mentorship, Shree Pratishtan provides a platform where youngsters channel their passion and energy into constructive community building.
testimonials.t3Desc: Organizing regular mass blood donation drives, health checkups, and Yoga Day camps brings critical life-saving relief to families across Nashik.
testimonials.t4Desc: From our grand 10-day Shree Ganeshotsav to the vibrant Gudipadwa Swagat Yatra, every celebration brings hundreds of families together in cultural pride and harmony.
testimonials.t5Desc: The teamwork, mutual trust, and coordination we forged on the cricket pitch in 2006 have made our festival management and safety operations a benchmark in Nashik.
testimonials.t6Desc: Social unity and dedicated community service are our core pillars. Shree Pratishtan continues to stand beside local families in times of celebration and need alike.

vision.quote: To build a united, active, and socially responsible community where people come together to celebrate culture, support one another, encourage youth participation, and contribute towards the overall development and well-being of society.

successStories.heading: Voices from Indira Nagar & Nashik
successStories.subtitle: First-hand experiences reflecting the transformative power of collective community service and youth dedication.
successStories.s1Story: Rahul and his classmates received complete study kits, notebooks, and school bags during Shree Pratishtan's annual education drive. This material assistance relieved the financial strain on his family, enabling him to continue his schooling with enthusiasm.
successStories.s2Story: During an emergency surgery, Mahendra's family urgently required O-negative blood units. Shree Pratishtan's active donor helpline mobilized a local Indira Nagar volunteer donor within 30 minutes, ensuring a timely and life-saving transfusion.
successStories.s3Story: Over the past seasons, our volunteer youth teams planted over 1,500 shade and fruit saplings across residential avenues and public spaces in Indira Nagar. Today, our community enjoys a visibly greener, cleaner, and healthier environment.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about timings, participation guidelines, and obtaining entry passes.
faq.q1: What are the Aarti & Darshan timings during Shree Ganeshotsav?
faq.a1: Daily Prabhat Aarti begins at 6:00 AM, afternoon community darshan runs through 1:00 PM, and the grand 108-lamp evening Maha Aarti commences at 7:30 PM at the Indira Nagar Mandal Ground, Nashik.
faq.q2: Who can participate in the Gudipadwa Swagat Yatra & Cricket Tournaments?
faq.a2: Our cultural processions, health drives, and annual cricket championships are open to all citizens, families, and youth clubs across Indira Nagar and Nashik district. Registration is free and welcome to all.
faq.q3: Are events free and how do I obtain an entry or booking pass?
faq.a3: All cultural festivals, aartis, and health camps are completely free for the public. You can generate an instant digital pass with QR verification directly on our Event Booking portal.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers about volunteering roles, eligibility, schedules, and certificates.
faq.q1: Who is eligible to volunteer with Shree Pratishtan?
faq.a1: Anyone aged 16 and above residing in Indira Nagar or Nashik who is passionate about cultural heritage, youth empowerment, sports, or social welfare is welcome to join. No prior experience is needed.
faq.q2: What is the time commitment required?
faq.a2: We offer flexible involvement. You can volunteer during major seasonal festivals (like Gudipadwa Swagat Yatra or Ganeshotsav), weekend blood donation camps, or annual cricket tournaments.
faq.q3: Do volunteers receive an official Trust Certificate?
faq.a3: Yes. Shree Pratishtan issues an official certificate from Late Dharmaraj Badode Bahu-Uddeshiya Sevabhavi Sanstha (Reg: nashik/0000153/2018) recognizing your contribution, hours, and leadership.
faq.q4: How are new volunteers guided and supported?
faq.a4: Our core committee of 20 founding pillars and 100+ active organizers provides hands-on orientation and mentorship for every cultural procession, health camp, and sports league.
faq.desc1: Understand open membership criteria, age requirements, and welcoming community guidelines.
faq.desc2: Discover weekend drives, festival shifts, and adaptable sports event opportunities.
faq.desc3: Learn about official registered trust validation for educational and career portfolios.
faq.desc4: Experience dedicated teamwork, safety briefings, and collaborative event leadership.

location.desc: We welcome patrons, volunteers, and event partners to our registered headquarters in Indira Nagar, Nashik. To ensure coordinator availability, please connect ahead of your visit.
location.hqDesc: Conveniently accessible via Mumbai-Agra Highway and Nashik Road.

social.heading: Follow Our Community Channels

cta.heading: Ready to Make an Active Impact?
cta.desc: Whether you want to sponsor student study kits, participate in 50+ blood donation drives, support youth sports leagues, or join cultural festivals in Indira Nagar, Nashik, we welcome you.
